title: Server → client props must be serializable

slides.say: A Server Component passing props to a Client Component sends them across environments. They must be serializable.

slides.text: ✅ strings, numbers, booleans, null, arrays, Map, Set, Date, plain objects, JSX, Promises, Server Functions.
slides.say: Allowed: primitives, arrays, maps, sets, dates, plain objects, JSX, promises, and Server Functions.

slides.code:
// 🔴 not serializable
<Chart
  onHover={() => log()}   // plain function
  model={new ChartModel()} // class instance
/>
slides.say: Not allowed: ordinary functions that are not Server Functions, classes, and instances of your own classes.

slides.text: Pass data; let the Client Component create its own handlers.
slides.say: So pass plain data down, and let the Client Component create its own event handlers.
